text: I am Deepan Kulandaisami, a Software Engineer focused on backend systems, AI/ML, and full-stack application development. I have 1.5+ years of production experience building LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and Python backend systems with FastAPI, Django, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, PostgreSQL, vector databases, and cloud deployments. I hold a B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a Minor in Mathematical & Computational Sciences from NITK Surathkal (2020-2024).

Viewers and recruiters can download my official resume at any time by clicking the 'Download Resume' button in the navigation bar or hero section, or directly accessing the URL /resume (which serves my latest verified PDF resume: Deepan_Kulandaisami_Resume.pdf).

I work as an Associate Software Developer (AI Full Stack) at Bonbloc AI (Apr 2025 – Present). In my role, I develop production AI software, high-performance Python backend services (FastAPI, Django), real-time streaming architectures (WebSockets, SSE, Celery), authentication systems (Keycloak, Azure AD/MSAL), PostgreSQL database workflows, and containerized deployments using Docker and Azure Container Apps. Due to Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), my proprietary company projects are kept confidential, and I demonstrate my architectural capabilities through my personal open-source projects.

I am based in Bangalore, Karnataka (open to in-office, hybrid, or remote opportunities in or around Bangalore). Regarding compensation and salary expectations, my package starts from 10 LPA. I am actively looking for software engineering roles in backend engineering, AI systems, and full-stack development where I can solve complex problems.

I am deeply passionate about mathematics, algorithms, and computational modeling. Alongside my B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from NITK Surathkal (2020 to 2024), I completed a minor in Mathematical & Computational Sciences. I love applying mathematical foundations—such as linear algebra, probability, vector spaces, optimization, and discrete math—to real-world AI systems, including vector search geometry, Monte Carlo simulations, embeddings, and machine learning models.

NexusGraph is an Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestrator built using FastAPI, LangGraph, Python, Qdrant vector database, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, and Docker. It coordinates specialized sub-agents (Planner, Code Synthesizer, Query Validator, and Execution Engine) with stateful cycles, human-in-the-loop approvals, and self-healing error recovery. Users can view the live demo and inspect the open-source code on GitHub.

DocuMind is an Agentic Multimodal RAG & Document Intelligence System built with FastAPI, LangChain, Milvus, PyMuPDF, Tesseract OCR, Groq LLMs, and Redis. It handles complex scanned PDFs, tabular reports, and technical documentation using layout-aware chunking, hybrid vector/keyword retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and hallucination evaluation guardrails.

QueryGenie is a Self-Healing Natural Language to SQL Studio developed with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, LangGraph, SQLGlot, and Docker. It dynamically discovers database schemas, validates query abstract syntax trees (AST), runs trial executions in a sandbox, and implements an error-feedback loop that feeds database exceptions back into the agent for automated SQL correction and retry.

OmniVoice is a Real-Time Streaming Conversational Agent built with FastAPI, WebSockets, OpenAI Whisper, Sarvam AI voice APIs, FFmpeg, and AsyncIO. It provides duplex voice-to-voice interaction with sub-second latency, streaming audio transcription, asynchronous tool calling, and expressive speech synthesis.

CricPredict is an ML Match Analytics & Monte Carlo Simulation Engine built using Python, FastAPI, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, and Streamlit. It derives deep performance insights from ball-by-ball cricket data, featuring real-time win probability curves, batter-bowler match-up models, and 10,000-run Monte Carlo simulations.

ProposalCraft is an Autonomous Business RFP & Document Generator built with FastAPI, Python, LangGraph, ReportLab, python-docx, and Pydantic. It ingests client requirements and RFP documents, structures executive proposals using agentic planning, and exports production-ready PDF, PPTX, and DOCX files.

I have hands-on experience working with Python data science and ETL tools, specifically Pandas and NumPy. In projects like CricPredict, I use Pandas for data cleaning, tabular transformations, time-series aggregations, and feature engineering for machine learning and Monte Carlo simulation pipelines.

I treat LLMs as one component of a larger software system rather than assuming model output is automatically correct. My AI engineering approach includes grounding, schema/context preparation, validation, execution feedback, retries, error handling, and robust debugging across model, backend, API, and database layers.

I have working knowledge of C++, data structures and algorithms, object-oriented programming, STL, memory management, RAII, smart pointers, multithreading, and concurrency. I also have working knowledge of TCP/IP networking and packet analysis with Wireshark.

I completed my B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK) Surathkal (2020 - 2024), along with a minor in Mathematical & Computational Sciences.
I hold Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204, Certification ID: E83442-7985BF) and Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900, Certification ID: 3672EB-85BFR0).
